steps.description: Skipped: LUFS normalization (EBU R128) is a standard, well-documented technique; no literature validation is needed beyond t0011's prior research and its own creative-thinking findings.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Skipped: not in data-analysis optional_steps; task operates entirely on local audio data and prior task code, no new external information needed.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Review t0011's per_clip_stats.jsonl, audit_audio.py, and thresholds as the starting point for the corrected audit and normalization code.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Design the corrected clipping metric, LUFS normalization pipeline, post-normalization re-check, and manifest/comparison outputs.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Skipped: task is CPU-only (pyloudnorm + soundfile on 1557 clips), no remote compute needed.

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Implement clipped_fraction metric, LUFS-normalize the v5 corpus, re-check normalized audio, and write the clean manifest and comparison outputs.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Skipped: setup-machines was skipped, no remote machines to tear down.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Explore the Key Questions: genuine clipping count, new clipping introduced by the gain change, manifest size vs baselines, and interaction with short-duration/silence flags.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, metrics.json, costs.json, and comparison charts.

steps.name: suggestions
